canonicalRequirements.statement: Activate the exact R0007 post-build law while preserving R0006, R0005, R0004, all published MINI bytes, the 1073 audited FULL product files and the audited FULL code identity unchanged. R0007 carries G26-PREBUILD-02 through G26-PREBUILD-10 and packagingRequirements forward byte-identically from R0006, records the single R0006 canonical FULL build as consumed and independently audited PASS, and authorizes only publication preparation of the exact audited FULL bytes. It does not authorize any FULL generation, closure, confirmation, GATE27, GEE R8, commit or push.

One FULL query unit is one canonical published GATE25 ANALOGUE_INDEX record, consumed exactly once in ascending analogueIdentityId order. The frozen query count is exactly 68562. A valid query with insufficient predictive evidence emits ABSTAIN and is never omitted; a structurally invalid source record fails closed.

Bind the already-published GATE25 analogue cohort and provenance, P3H dataset identity, and GATE22 horizons 30/90/180/252 read-only. No Yahoo refetch, P3H regeneration, GATE25 regeneration, or GATE21 through GATE25 mutation.

FULL cardinality remains exact: 68562 ensemble records and 68562 provenance records. Page size is 128 records, yielding 536 ensemble pages and 536 provenance pages. The FULL cohort is one manifest plus 1072 pages, exactly 1073 product files; R0005 authorizes those product files only through the explicit three-predicate FULL authorization law.

Freeze the paged envelope identities GATE26_FULL_MANIFEST_V1, GATE26_FULL_ENSEMBLE_PAGE_V1 and GATE26_FULL_PROVENANCE_PAGE_V1. The manifest binds ordered page number, first and last analogueIdentityId, record count, content SHA256, byte length, LFS OID, product version, input cohort identity and paired provenance identity. Pagination never changes V1 record semantics.

The FULL design reuses each published GATE25 selected analogue cohort and attaches only its P3H outcomes over four horizons. Complexity is O(Q x A x H + Q + P) record work, serialization and hashing. O(Q x U), a whole-universe scan per query, and repeated O(n^2) append or sort are forbidden.

Freeze deterministic checkpoint and resume semantics before FULL generation: off-repo durable checkpoints bind exact input, code, contract and completed paired-page identities; ensemble and provenance pages finalize as one pair; duplicate or divergent replay fails closed; restart after process or machine failure resumes without restart from zero and yields byte-identical final product.

Freeze a bounded-memory FULL consumer that verifies the manifest first, then exact ordered page presence, SHA256, byte length, LFS materialized bytes, product version, provenance pairing and record identity. Missing, duplicate, corrupt, reordered or mixed-cohort pages fail closed. No FULL parse occurs in the Wheel scan hot path.

The exact FULL LFS transport rule is a consumed prerequisite and must remain present exactly once: data/jarvise/predictive-ensemble/GATE26/V1/FULL/** filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text. Builders emit canonical content bytes; Git LFS alone owns pointer conversion. Manual LFS pointers are forbidden.

R0005 authorizes deterministic FULL production only through the explicit three-predicate law, while preserving the frozen implementation, schemas, V1 record semantics, targeted hostiles and recovery/resource limits. No product-semantic expansion, closure, confirmation, GATE27, commit or push is authorized.

This is a ledger-bound IN_PROGRESS to IN_PROGRESS CONTRACT_SUCCESSION from R0006 to R0007 under the distinct single-use authority GATE_CONTRACT_SUCCESSION_LOCAL_AUTHORITY_R0007.json. State advances to GATE26 state revision R0008, which records GATE26_CANONICAL_FULL_BUILD_R1 COMPLETE and its independent delta audit PASS, and ledger event 118 consumes the authority. No START replay, status change, closure or ACTIVE_GATE mutation.

The R0006 canonical FULL production authority is consumed: GATE26_CANONICAL_FULL_BUILD_R1 ran exactly once and is independently audited PASS (GATE26_CANONICAL_FULL_BUILD_R1_INDEPENDENT_DELTA_AUDIT_PASS). Under R0007 no FULL generation of any intent is authorized; the unchanged R0006-pinned production code refuses every build or replay (CURRENT_CONTRACT_NOT_R0006) and that refusal is the expected post-build behaviour. The audited FULL product (exactly 1073 files, manifest sha256 bound here) and the audited FULL code identity are frozen byte-identical and are prepared only for publication through the existing FULL Git LFS transport rule. Builders never write LFS pointers; Git LFS alone owns pointer conversion.

Pointer to exact R0007 successor contract

positiveTests.case: exact 68562-query cohort and 68562 paired outputs derive from canonical ordered GATE25 records
536 paired pages at size 128 cover every query exactly once and resume byte-identically
bounded-memory consumer verifies manifest, materialized LFS bytes and paired provenance
R0006 authority loads with exactly 1073 enumerated FULL paths, CANONICAL_FULL intent and V2 producer/resource documents with fullGenerationAuthorized true
the 1073 audited FULL files, manifest sha256 and audited FULL code identity are byte-identical under R0007 and every FULL path resolves to the existing Git LFS rule

negativeTests.case: any O(Q x U) path or repeated O(n^2) append-sort
missing or invalid R0005 FULL authorization predicate, or any FULL production attempt outside the exact authorized product root
missing, duplicate, reordered, corrupt or mixed-cohort page
Yahoo refetch, P3H regeneration, GATE25 regeneration or network during compute

REAL_PILOT or PREBUILD_REHEARSAL writing into the FULL product root, CANONICAL_FULL over a non-canonical cohort or outside the FULL root, a missing or extra FULL path, or a V2 document with fullGenerationAuthorized false
any FULL build, rehearsal or replay against the live repository under R0007, including a second CANONICAL_FULL build

countertests.case: manual LFS pointer or pointer without materialized object
R0005 presented as closure, confirmation or GATE27 authority, or R0004 used as a fallback production key
R0005 or R0004 presented as the current FULL write authority, or a second canonical FULL build over a finalized checkpoint
R0006 presented as current FULL write authority after consumption, or a repinned production module changing the audited FULL code identity

reuseRules: Reuse published GATE25 analogue selections and provenance read-only.
Reuse GATE26 V1 MINI record semantics and hostile evidence unless causally invalidated.
Reuse the consumed FULL LFS transport prerequisite; do not republish it.
Reuse R0005 requirements G26-PREBUILD-02 through G26-PREBUILD-10, packagingRequirements and the five FULL binding artifacts byte-identically.
Reuse the accepted Phase D real producer, bounded pilot and recovery evidence; the V2 resource budget carries every V1 limit unchanged.
Reuse the audited GATE26_CANONICAL_FULL_BUILD_R1 product, manifest, checkpoint and evidence byte-identically; never regenerate.
Reuse the existing FULL Git LFS transport rule for publication; no new transport mechanism.
invalidationRules: Any drift in a pinned input blocks PREBUILD.
Any query omission or duplicate invalidates cardinality proof.
Any FULL production attempt that does not satisfy all three explicit R0005 predicates is unauthorized.
Any network access during compute invalidates the rehearsal.
Any baseHead drift before succession consumption stops the transaction.
Any FULL product file outside the exact 1073 enumerated paths invalidates the build.
Any resource limit breach stops the build before the next page pair.
Any byte change in the 1073 audited FULL files or the audited FULL code identity invalidates R0007.
closureConditions: R0007 records the consumed canonical FULL build and cannot close GATE26.
Publication preparation does not imply AGENT_CLOSURE, COMPLETE_AGENT, COMPLETE_CONFIRMED or independent audit PASS.
Closure must later prove the exact FULL cohort, fresh-clone LFS materialization, bounded consumption and no future leakage.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: No GATE27 authority is created by R0007.
No AGENT_CLOSURE or EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION authority is created by R0007.

checkpointPolicy.resume: GATE26 IN_PROGRESS R0008 after CONTRACT_SUCCESSION R0006 to R0007; GATE26_CANONICAL_FULL_BUILD_R1 COMPLETE and independently audited PASS; R0006 FULL authority consumed; audited FULL product prepared for existing Git LFS publication
checkpointPolicy.reuse: audited FULL product, manifest, code identity, off-repository checkpoints and evidence; R0006 requirement and packaging bindings
